mapper.sql: id, elderly_user_id, elderly_name, record_id, bind_id, receiver_role, receiver_name, receiver_open_id, caregiver_id, risk_level, title, content, voice_text, status, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_notify (elderly_user_id, elderly_name, record_id, bind_id, receiver_role, receiver_name, receiver_open_id, caregiver_id, risk_level, title, content, voice_text, status, create_time) VALUES (#{elderlyUserId}, #{elderlyName}, #{recordId}, #{bindId}, #{receiverRole}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverOpenId}, #{caregiverId}, #{riskLevel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{voiceText}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'unread'), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE health_notify SET status = 'read' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM health_notify WHERE receiver_open_id = #{openId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM health_notify WHERE caregiver_id = #{caregiverId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_notify WHERE receiver_open_id = #{openId} AND status = 'unread'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_notify WHERE caregiver_id = #{caregiverId} AND status = 'unread'
